sources.decision: Use the visible area with browser UI expanded as the budget. Do not guess address-bar offsets or stretch/footer-resize during gestures.
Reuse native buttons and Enter/Space, coordinate aria-expanded/controls/hidden/labelledby; permit one panel in each row.

structure: Two headings, then two full-width panels in each row; same-row exclusive expansion; rows independent. All 43 labels/destinations retained. PC footer markup identical. No scroll locking or forced scroll added.
limits: Small/large viewport heights coincide in desktop emulation; real iPhone toolbars and rubber-band need device acceptance.
header_display: When the whole compact footer fits within the visible area, hide the header completely. Otherwise retain actual phone-overlap push. No page height/scroll position mutation.
